title: HandPoseLiveData
description: DRAFT, not confirmed by the model engine's builders: don't depend on it before 1.0.0. The `data` of one `result` message on the `results` channel of a `fenon/hand-pose-hm` live session. Which frame it belongs to and the size of that frame are in the message itself (`frame_id`, `rtp_timestamp`, `media_time_90k`, `frame_width`, `frame_height`); pixel coordinates here refer to that frame. The hand fields are those of the per-frame rows of `fenon.hand_pose.video` 1.0.0, so one parser reads both. Size: a result with two hands at full float precision is about 8 KB; about four hands would pass the results channel's 16 KB limit and be dropped, so the engine should round coordinates (open with the engine's builders).

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera the model assumed for this frame. Sent with every result, because the resolution can change during a session.

focal_length_px.description: Focal length in pixels of this frame.

assumed.description: True when the focal length is the model's assumption, not a calibration.

joint_order.description: The order of the 21 joints in every per-joint array.

raw_hand_count.description: Hands the model found before duplicates were removed.

hands.description: Hands kept after duplicate removal. Order is not significant.

point2.title: Point2
point2.description: [x, y], or [null, null] when the joint can't be projected (z <= 1e-6).

pixel_landmarks.description: Pixels of the frame, origin top-left, x right, y down.

normalized_landmarks.description: pixel_landmarks divided by frame_width and frame_height.

landmarks_3d_camera.description: Metres, camera frame: origin at the optical centre, x right, y down, z forward. Depth is scale-consistent, not metric.

bbox_xyxy.description: Box around the projectable joints in pixels, or four nulls when none are projectable.
